Drafted by the weekly job (`.github/workflows/candidates.yml`).

**Nothing here is in the season yet.** These are candidates. Promotion into
`questions/season0.json` is a human commit, and that is the step which makes a
round contamination-proof rather than merely scheduled — the generator refuses
to write that file at all.

Read the listing below rather than the diff. It carries each candidate's
schedule, its signal-to-noise ratio and its weekly movement, and every refusal
with the gate that produced it. A candidate flagged `barely moves` is one to
think about; the threshold behind that flag is deliberately not set yet, and
setting it needs resolved rounds (#67).

Two families roll themselves forward from a reviewed original and should look
routine here: `wiki-top10` and `trends-basket`. Anything else new is worth a
second look.
